text:
### Business Purpose  
**Required for:**
- Business customers
- Accounts with unusual transaction patterns
- High-value accounts  
**Information Collected:**
- Business type and nature
- Expected transaction volumes
- Expected geographic markets
- Beneficial ownership (if not natural person)
